fields.Szenariobeschreibung: A scaling method was used to calculate the LCA results for the different Enka®Grip products. The scaling was done on the basis of mass per square meter. As a result of scaling there are results for both the fixed and the scalable part of the scaling function. The fixed part means that this number is the same for each product in the product group and the scalable part is the part that depends on the mass per unit area of the product. In order to calculate the correct number of each environmental impact category for each of the products in the product group, the following calculation should be done: [number fixed part]+([specific mass]*[number scalable part]). Note: The results table shown in this data set refers to the product Enka®Grip&Drain 7010/300.50PET/5004F/M110PP with the specific mass of 1.25 kg/m^2.
